sections.name: Candidate and role
sections.asr_prompt: Candidate and role details. Candidate name, role, seniority, team, interview round, interviewers, interview format.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One or two lines: candidate, role and round, interviewers present.

sections.name: Interview summary
sections.asr_prompt: Interview summary. Questions asked, exercises, system design, case study, answers, communication style, experience discussed.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Concise summary of what was covered and how the candidate performed, grouped by topic.

sections.name: Strengths
sections.asr_prompt: Candidate strengths. Strong signal, deep knowledge, clear communication, ownership, leadership, relevant experience, culture add.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Bullet list of strengths, each backed by a concrete observation from the interview.

sections.name: Concerns
sections.asr_prompt: Concerns and gaps. Weak signal, gap, shallow answer, struggled with, red flag, needs support, seniority mismatch.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Bullet list of concerns, each backed by a concrete observation; distinguish dealbreakers from coachable gaps.

sections.name: Recommendation
sections.asr_prompt: Hiring recommendation. Strong hire, hire, no hire, strong no hire.
